description: This file contains the implementation of the 'Directionality' plugin for TinyMCE, providing functionality to switch text directionality (LTR/RTL) within the editor. It defines the plugin object with methods for retrieving plugin info, rendering control HTML, executing commands to change text direction, and handling node change events to update UI state.

classes.name: TinyMCE_DirectionalityPlugin
classes.description: An object defining the TinyMCE plugin for managing text directionality, including methods for retrieving plugin info, control HTML, executing commands, and handling node change events.

methods.name: getInfo()
methods.description: Returns metadata about the plugin, including name, author, URLs, and version.

methods.name: getControlHTML(cn)
methods.description: Provides HTML for control buttons based on command name ('ltr' or 'rtl').

methods.name: execCommand(editor_id, element, command, user_interface, value)
methods.description: Executes directionality commands ('mceDirectionLTR' or 'mceDirectionRTL') to set the 'dir' attribute on the proper parent element.

methods.name: handleNodeChange(editor_id, node, undo_index, undo_levels, visual_aid, any_selection)
methods.description: Handles updates when the editor's node selection changes, updating button states based on the current element's 'dir' attribute.

ctags.name: execCommand
ctags.pattern: /^	execCommand : function(editor_id, element, command, user_interface, value) {$/

ctags.name: handleNodeChange
ctags.pattern: /^	handleNodeChange : function(editor_id, node, undo_index, undo_levels, visual_aid, any_selection/
